request.text: I’ve cleared the straight path between you and the garden gate, and Pepper is secured indoors. Look at me first, then walk forward toward the gate, and tell me when those two actions are complete.

responsibilities.outcome: Look at the user before beginning locomotion.
After looking at the user, walk forward toward the garden gate along the stated clear path.
Report when both requested body actions have completed.

new_goals.description: Look at the user before moving.
constraints: Complete this action before walking forward.
success_criteria: The look-at-person action completes before locomotion begins.

new_goals.description: Walk forward toward the garden gate.
new_goals.source_text: then walk forward toward the gate
constraints: Begin only after the look action completes.
Use the user-stated clear straight path.
success_criteria: The requested forward-walk action completes after the look action.

new_goals.description: Tell the user when both embodied actions are complete.
new_goals.source_text: tell me when those two actions are complete
constraints: Do not report completion before trusted outcomes exist for both actions.
success_criteria: A completion report follows successful evidence for the look and walk actions.

semantic_facts: The plan must preserve the explicit order: look at the user, then walk forward, then report completion.
The speech Goal depends on trusted completion outcomes from both embodied Goals and cannot serve as their substitute.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims both actions are complete before their execution outcomes are available.
The assistant claims it reached, opened, or secured the garden gate when only forward walking was requested.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Ordered physical Goals are parallelized or reversed despite an explicit user sequence.
A requested completion report is emitted optimistically instead of being gated on trusted action outcomes.
